title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: customer-first direct callback with callback profiles
summary: The callback flow, irreversible enablement warning, licensing model and roadmap details are supported. The claimed absence of enablement automation could not be established: Dataverse exposes a writable Direct Callback configuration with an Enabled field, without explaining its relationship to irreversible customer-first onboarding. Two navigation paths also stop before the settings they describe.

claims.claim: The roadmap record was modified at 2026-10-22T23:45:45.
Classic direct callback assigns the request to a representative before calling the customer, leaving the representative waiting during the attempt.
claims.quote: In the classic direct callback experience, the system assigns a callback request to a representative before it calls the customer.

claims.claim: Customer-first direct callback calls the customer first when the request reaches the front of the queue.
claims.quote: With customer-first direct callback, the system calls the customer first when the callback request reaches the front of the queue.

claims.claim: The representative joins after the customer answers and completes any required verification.
claims.quote: After the customer answers and completes any required verification, the system connects the customer to an available representative.

claims.claim: Callback initiation requires the request to reach the front of the queue and at least one representative to be available.
claims.quote: When the callback request reaches the front of the queue and at least one representative is available, the system initiates the callback.

claims.fix: Narrow controls[0].governs and its rendered label to 'Complete irreversible customer-first callback onboarding, including Callback Agent provisioning'; retain api null only for that complete sequence. Append this note and cite https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/customer-service/develop/reference/entities/msdyn_proactive_callback_config: 'Dataverse documents PATCH /msdyn_proactive_callback_configs(msdyn_proactive_callback_configid), with writable msdyn_enabled and msdyn_callback_type (192350000 = Direct Callback).
